from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal

class ParsedDocument(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single judgment document for classification."""
    document_title: str = Field(description="The actual title of the judgment document found in the text")
    case_category: Literal["行政主体 - 房屋拆迁管理（拆迁）", "刑事赔偿", "不动产登记纠纷", "知识产权与竞争", "产品责任纠纷", "行政行为 - 行政给付"] | None = Field(description="The legal cause of action matching the task's 6 categories, or None if the document does not fit any")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """The result of parsing one input document."""
    extracted_documents: list[ParsedDocument]
